purpose: Prevent reintroduction of unsupported frontend semantic decisions, semantic loss during transport and duplicate business-value interpretation paths.

enforcement_layers.type: Contract value carriers preserve raw value, field identity and presentation context.
enforcement_layers.static: Source scanning rejects unregistered semantic bypasses and invented defaults.
enforcement_layers.behavior: Component and unit tests exercise fail-closed and semantic-preservation cases.
enforcement_layers.contract: Producer/consumer assertions reconcile declared field semantics.
enforcement_layers.evidence: The source-backed matrix binds each applicable semantic to real evidence.

allowlist_policy.scope: single repository path, exact rule and reviewed reason

rules.title: Declared fields use the contract-aware semantic authority
rules.failure_prevented: A generic or component-local formatter independently decides business meaning.
rules.pass_condition: Every production consumer of a declared business field resolves semantic kind through the approved authority.
negative_cases: percentage componentKey passed as generic float
duration widget treated as ordinary number
status field falls through to raw text
money bypasses declared currency and digits

rules.title: Unknown selection values fail closed
rules.failure_prevented: The UI exposes a raw storage key as if it were a business label.
rules.pass_condition: A value absent from a declared selection enters a visible contract-gap state; no surface returns the key as display text.
negative_cases: List unknown selection
Kanban unknown selection
Readonly Detail unknown selection
changed translation or label does not alter behavior

rules.title: No frontend-invented precision, unit or percentage
rules.failure_prevented: A missing declaration is replaced by a plausible frontend default.
rules.pass_condition: Missing digits, unit, currency or percentage identity produces a contract gap; the frontend does not choose 2 decimals, percent or another business value.
negative_cases: My Work money lacks digits
Progress row lacks unit
percentage-like float lacks componentKey
numeric raw value exceeds a visual range

rules.title: Field descriptors and componentKey are preserved
rules.failure_prevented: A generic readonly or fallback path drops type, widget, selection, digits or componentKey.
rules.pass_condition: Every contract-declared field reaching a presentation component carries the complete applicable descriptor.
negative_cases: FieldValue receives percentage field
ProfessionalBaseFieldControl receives duration field
Kanban title fallback receives a declared field
Hierarchy value receives status field

rules.title: No semantic stringification in transport adapters
rules.failure_prevented: A bridge converts values to text before the final renderer can interpret type or identity.
rules.pass_condition: Readonly collection and page-block bridges preserve raw values and semantic envelopes; intentional plain text is explicitly registered.
negative_cases: String(record[field]) in readonly bridge
JSON.stringify(object) as Page Block business value
money and digits lost before table rendering
attachment reference reduced to a label

rules.title: Relation identity is preserved or rejected
rules.failure_prevented: A many-to-one or many-to-many value is shown as a bare numeric ID.
rules.pass_condition: Relation values retain record identity and display name; a bare ID without declared identity handling is treated as a contract gap.
negative_cases: tuple with missing label
object with only id
stringified tuple
many2many collection degraded to comma-separated IDs

rules.title: Attachment behavior uses identity and role
rules.failure_prevented: Field labels or display strings determine attachment behavior.
rules.pass_condition: Attachment count, reference, preview and download consume a stable declared role and identity; ordinary integers and labels never trigger attachment actions.
negative_cases: localized label changes
ordinary integer resembles an attachment count
URL text is not an attachment record
missing attachment role fails closed

rules.title: Display format never becomes an ORM input value
rules.failure_prevented: Locale separators, currency symbols or human-readable status text are persisted.
rules.pass_condition: Input and command builders consume raw ORM-compatible values while presentation functions remain display-only.
negative_cases: formatted decimal used in payload
status label used instead of selection key
relation display name used instead of record ID
formatted datetime used as ORM value

rules.title: One business semantic has one interpretation authority
rules.failure_prevented: Two production interpreters disagree for the same declared field.
rules.pass_condition: Compatibility helpers either delegate semantic decisions or are unreachable for contract-declared fields.
negative_cases: contract-aware and generic unknown-selection results differ
percentage is formatted differently by list and form
relation object has different fallback by surface
empty and boolean values vary by surface

rules.title: Unresolved contract gaps are explicit and fail closed
rules.failure_prevented: A frontend fallback hides a missing backend declaration.
rules.pass_condition: Every missing required semantic has a registered gap identity, owning declaration layer and visible fail-closed behavior.
negative_cases: missing unit silently becomes percent
missing digits silently becomes two decimals
missing attachment role is guessed from a label
missing timezone falls back to the host browser timezone

non_claims: does not prove backend ORM correctness
does not prove ACL or action authorization
does not replace runtime timezone readback
does not replace attachment authorization tests
does not replace full business journey or deployment acceptance
